tests.reason: A2 ships dark: HEALTH_STORE_ENABLED is forced off when VITANA_ENV=staging (store-status reports {enabled:false, reason:'staging'} to a signed-in member, proven by routes/health-store-internal.test.ts because the http runner signs nobody in), the store's tables are Aurora-only and absent from the shared Supabase project, and no raw bucket exists, so on staging nothing reads or writes health data. The read-only GETs above prove the internal router is mounted, refuses unauthenticated callers with JSON, and leaves the existing /api/v1/health router untouched. Every write path (writeHealthSamples' S3 contract, consent gate, raw archive, validation/quarantine, chunking, partition retry, quota, idempotency, readers, suppression, change hook, maintenance, reprocess, erase-raw, the infra scripts' dry runs) is proven by Jest over the in-memory twin of the A1 SQL functions and a fake S3 client; POST probes are never sent to staging.
